verdict.rationale: Solid's own README states it is "Web component friendly and can author custom elements" [solid-gh-7]. That is a first-party claim for this story, but it is a single one-line mention with no detail on how authoring works or how standards-compliant the output is. Missing for 10: documentation of the custom-element authoring API or tooling, details on Shadow DOM and attribute/property handling, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
